summary: Notifin Fase 1 MVP tested end-to-end. Backend: 17/18 pytest cases pass (94.4%). Auth (register/login/me/logout/duplicate/wrong-pass/google-session-invalid), Subscription CRUD, category+status filters, freemium 4th-sub 403 with detail.code='limit_reached', mock upgrade unlocking unlimited, dashboard structure (total_this_month/projection/upcoming/by_category/active_count), channels PUT, soft-delete all pass. Only /api/register-push fails: returns 500 'EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY missing or invalid' instead of gracefully skipping (placeholder key in .env). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Login/Register flow works and redirects to Dashboard; bottom tabs Beranda/Langganan/Akun navigate; Langganan screen renders category + status filter chips (horizontal scroll, no wrap), FAB opens form, saving creates sub and returns to list (verified created card visible); Account tab shows profile + logout. No red-screen errors. Console warnings only: `shadow*` deprecated and `pointerEvents` prop deprecation (from libs).

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 500 ('EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY missing or invalid') when EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY is placeholder. Per Fase 1 spec, endpoint should be non-blocking. In server.py:register_push the 401 path raises HTTPException(500), which is re-raised past the fallback `except Exception` block. Suggest: on placeholder/401 from provider, return {'status':'skipped'} (200) instead of 500, so mobile clients installing on Expo Go do not see a crash.

issues: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' (react-native-web). Non-blocking but should migrate `shadow.card` / `shadow.soft` in /app/frontend/src/theme to use boxShadow for web.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (likely from @gorhom/bottom-sheet or gesture-handler). Non-blocking.

action_items: Fix /api/register-push non-blocking behavior: when provider returns 401 (missing/invalid EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY), return {'status':'skipped'} with HTTP 200 rather than raising 500. Currently, on native builds without a real push key the mobile app's registerPush call would throw an ApiError and, while wrapped in try/catch on the client, still adds noise. Alternatively, only raise 500 in non-placeholder configurations.
Migrate deprecated `shadow*` React Native style props to `boxShadow` in the theme (frontend/src/theme.ts or similar) to silence RN 0.81 web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 33 (EMERGENT_AUTH_URL): using ad-hoc httpx.AsyncClient(...).get without `async with` leaks a client per request; use module-level _auth_client or `async with httpx.AsyncClient()` pattern.
server.py: FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI 0.109+; prefer lifespan context manager.

server.py: `plan == 'free'` freemium check calls active_count() which uses `deleted_at: None`; correct. However `plan` defaults to 'free' but existing users without the field are treated as free — OK.
AuthContext.tsx: `processedSessionIds` is a module-level Set that grows unbounded across app lifetime; fine for MVP but consider clearing.
api.ts: apiFetch reads token via async storage on EVERY call. For heavy screens (dashboard + list), consider a single in-memory read (already partially cached via inMemoryToken).
seed_data_creation: No seed budi@test.com auto-created — tests register fresh users (test_*@example.com) and clean up. Backend test 'test_login_seeded_or_fallback' will create budi@test.com if it does not exist.

rca_of_issue: register-push 500 RCA: server.py register_push() branch `if resp.status_code == 401: raise HTTPException(500, ...)`. HTTPException is caught earlier in the outer `except HTTPException: raise`, so the graceful `except Exception -> return {'status':'skipped'}` fallback is bypassed. Reproduction: POST /api/register-push with any body while backend/.env has EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY=placeholder. Mitigation: change the 401 branch to `return {'status':'skipped'}` instead of raising, OR keep raising but only when key is a real (non-placeholder) value.
